reason: In src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:346-347, join() only calls terminate() when isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is true. The processes come from get_context("spawn").Process, a SpawnProcess. In CPython both SpawnProcess and multiprocessing.Process subclass BaseProcess, but neither subclasses the other, so the check is always False and terminate() never runs; the same check was already there before the patch (old self.process check, patch lines 375-376).
